generator: NumPy Generator with explicit PCG64 and this fixed seed; recipe and complete source-file hash bound by the prediction plan. No resampling or replacement after observations.
weight_row_mapping: Full-shape row j uses frozen generated bank row j modulo512; input occupies the last row of a contiguous BF16 [1,30,640] carrier.

case_recipes.dense_narrow: Random signs/mantissas and unbiased encoded exponent integers116 through133 for input and weights.
case_recipes.dense_wide: Random signs/mantissas and encoded exponent integers80 through169 for input and weights.
case_recipes.cancellation: Unit input; each32-position group contains8 large terms (encoded exponents150..160),8 small terms(115..125),negated large terms,the same small terms.
case_recipes.rounding_boundary: Unit input; three nonzero or signed-zero terms at row-index-derived positions separated by8, probing BF16 half-way rounding and signed epsilon. Other weights zero.

prediction_gate: Freeze all four integer-only synthetic predictions and the recalculated baseline vocabulary prediction before any synthetic native projection. Existing baseline native outputs are already observed characterization data, not holdout evidence.
native_protocol: For each baseline/synthetic case perform three unprofiled,three warmup,three profiled projections; require full output equality, profiled/plain equality and the same observed gemvx kernel symbol. Fresh model weight/source/runtime checks for baseline. Synthetic weights are declared controlled matrices, not model parameters.
failure_rule: Retain failures; no arithmetic refit or input changes within this protocol. A matching kernel name is provenance, not a hardware reduction proof.
